title: neocodon beauverdianus
intro: Neocodon beauverdianus, commonly known as Beauverd's gentian, is a type of flowering plant in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Neocodon beauverdianus include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
